decision.summary: Within allowed context [555,650], a multi-axis transient is observed from index 590: N decreases, E increases, and U shows a brief dip near 600. The reversal of N and E trends initiates around 608–610, but the full return (i.e., re-establishment of pre-590 trend/level) is not confirmed before index 650. No isolated step or permanent offset dominates; morphology suggests a single evolving event rather than disjoint offsets, but absence of complete return prevents confirmation.

intervals.observation: N declines steadily from ~590 to ~608 while E rises; U dips transiently near 600, coinciding with inflection in N/E. Return of both N and E begins around 608–610 but is incomplete within allowed context (ends at 650); U recovers by ~612. Sustained interior behavior present, but opposing return not fully observed before context ends.
